![What's new in cheek 0.2.2](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Mailo037/cheek/v0.2.2/docs/releases/v0.2.2.png)

cheek 0.2.2 resolves public Glyph song, album and playlist shares through Glyph's web player.

- Download a shared song or a whole playlist in order. Playlist JSON can be saved with `-J` and read back with `--info-json`.
- Keep downloading the remaining songs when an entry fails; the command still exits with an error so missing songs stay visible.
- Preserve titles, artists and covers, and mark official 30-second previews. Incomplete web playlists fail explicitly instead of silently losing entries.

Includes Linux, Windows, macOS and all three Android binaries used by Hamstr. Verify downloads against `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
